visa.title: Visa & pasipɔɔri
visa.text: Pasipɔɔri min bɛ baara la kalo 6 segin don kɔ. Donni visa mago siya bɛɛ ye: e-visa ɛntɛrinɛti kan walima visa ambasadi la. I ka sɛbɛnw foto mara i ka minɛn kɔnɔ.

vaccines.title: Boloci & kɛnɛya tanga
vaccines.text: Fievre jaune boloci wajibiyalen (karti international bɛ lajɛ ni i sera). Sumaya fura ka fisa kosɛbɛ: taa vaccinations internationales yɔrɔ dɔgɔkun 4 na 6 sani i ka taama. DTP, hepatites A ni B, typhoide Changé.

season.title: Waati min na taa
season.text: Tilema kalo 11 na 2: waati ɲuman kosɛbɛ, ka mɔgɔ ye. Kalo 3-5: funteni kosɛbɛ (tuma caman 40 C sanfɛ). Kalo 6-10: samiya, kɔngɔw bɛ binɛ nka siraw ka gɛlɛn tuma dɔw.

money.title: Wari & sara
money.text: Wari: CFA franc (XOF). Sara ni wari yɔrɔ bɛɛ; banki karti bɛ baara sigi-yɔrɔ dama ni Wagadugu dɔrɔn. Wari bɔ distiribitɛriw la duguba kɔnɔ ka wari fitini mara.

security.title: Lakana & sira
security.text: I ka ministɛri laadilikan lajɛ sani i ka sira sugandi; mara dɔw tɛ diya. Taama tile fɛ, ni yɔrɔ ɲɛminɛbaga ni sigi-yɔrɔ dɔnnen. I tɔgɔ sɛbɛn ambasadi la ni a bɛ se.

packing.title: Min ka don valisi kɔnɔ
packing.text: Fani nɔgɔmanw min bɛ farikolo datugu, fugulan, ɲɛgɛnnaw, tile fura fanganman, sosow gɛnna, fura minɛn (sumaya fura, kɔnɔboli fura, ji sɔsɔli), lanpan, adaptɛri (priz type C/E, 220 V), ji butɛli filiterin.

health.title: Kɛnɛya mara
health.text: I ka ji min datigɛlen dɔrɔn walima min filiterin min. Glasi, nakɔfɛn kɛnɛ minw koni ni robinɛ ji, ni dumuni gwaman kana. I bolow ko tuma caman. I ka sumaya fura ta i n'a fɔra i ye, hali segin kɔ.

heat.title: Funteni & tile
heat.text: I ka ji min ka taa, kɔgɔ dɔɔni k'a fara i dumuni kan, i ka lafiya funteni waati la (12 na 15). Fugulan ni tile fura tuma bɛɛ. Funteni bana taamaseerew (kunkolodimi, ɲɛji, hakili ɲagami).

customs.title: Laada ni cogo
customs.text: Burkina jatigiya (teranga) ka di: waati ta ka mɔgɔw fo, o nafa ka bon. I ka i masiri ɲuman, sɔrɔla batofɛnw yɔrɔ la. I kininbolo ta ka di walima ka minɛ. A ɲininka tuma bɛɛ sani i ka mɔgɔ foto ta.

bargaining.title: Sanni ni tanya tɛ
bargaining.text: Sanni ye laada ye sugu la ni takisi la, sɔngɔ dafalen butiki la fewu. I ka yɛlɛmakan mara, ka sɔngɔ fɔ, ka bɛn sɔrɔ. Takisi sara bɛn sani i ka don a kɔnɔ.

connectivity.title: Telefɔni & ɛntɛrinɛti
connectivity.text: SIM karti jamanakɔnɔ (Orange, Moov) san ni i pasipɔɔri, awiyɔmbɔyɔrɔ la walima butiki la: data sɔngɔ ka nɔgɔ ani a bɛ diya duguba kɔnɔ. Sigi-yɔrɔ wifi bɛ sumaya. I ka kaartiw telesarize ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ.

language.title: Kan
language.text: Faransikan ye kan ba ye ani a famuyara duguba kɔnɔ. Moorekan kuma dɔw (ne y windga: aw ni sɔgɔma) walima Jula kumaw diya tuma bɛɛ ka daw yɛlɛ.

photos.title: Foto ni bonya
photos.text: Kana forobɔ walima sɔrɔdasi sow foto ta, walima awiyɔmbɔyɔrɔ. Yamaruya ɲininka mɔgɔw la; foli fitini ka di. Batoyɔrɔ senmayalen dɔw bɛ foto bali.

emergency.title: Nimɔrɔ nafamaw
emergency.text: Polisi: 17 - Tasumafagalaw / dɛmɛ: 18 - SAMU: 112. I ka ambasadi nimɔrɔ ni i ka asiransi rapatirimasɔn nimɔrɔ sɛbɛn. U mara ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ ani sɛbɛn kan.

healthWatch.title: Kɛnɛya kɔlɔsili segin kɔ
healthWatch.text: Ni funteni y'i sɔrɔ kalo 3 kɔnɔ segin kɔ, taa dɔgɔtɔrɔ fɛ joona ka i ka taama Burkina Faso fɔ: sumaya bɛ se ka bɔ kɔfɛ.

feedback.title: I ka kɔrɔ fɔ
feedback.text: Jaabi to sigi-yɔrɔ, ɲɛminɛbagaw ni dumuni-yɔrɔw kan: i bɛ taamakɛla nataw ni yɔrɔ baarakɛlaw dɛmɛ ka ɲɛ.

itineraries.title: Taama labɛnnenw
itineraries.subtitle: Siraw BurkinaSira sɛbɛnnikɛlaw ye min dilan: yɔrɔ sɛbɛnnenw, wari jate, laadilikanw. I mago min na, o ta ka o kɛ i ta ye.
itineraries.note: Wari jate mɔgɔ kelen na FCFA la, avion foronbila ni viza tɛ a kɔnɔ. O ye daminɛ ye: i ka fɛn bɛɛ Changé labɛn-minɛn na ni i ye sira ta.
itineraries.budgetHint: Sigi-yɔrɔ, dumuni, dugukolo bolimafɛn, ɲɛminɛbagaw ni donni. Avion foronbila ni viza tɛ a kɔnɔ.
itineraries.cloneNote: A bɛ taama dilan « N ka taamaw » kɔnɔ ni yɔrɔ bɛɛ. I bɛ se ka fɛn bɛɛ Changé o kɔ.
itineraries.cloneRequiresAuth: I ka don walisa ka nin sira in ta.
itineraries.cloned: Sira tara i ka taamaw kɔnɔ

nearMe.denied: Yɔrɔ dɔnniya banniyalen. A to i ka minɛn ka labenw kɔnɔ walisa ka i gɛrɛfɛn fɛnw ye.
nearMe.servicesOff: Yɔrɔ dɔnniya bɛ faga i ka telefɔni na. A yɛlɛma (Paramètres > Localisation) k'a sɔrɔ, ka a kɛ tugun.
nearMe.unavailable: Ma se ka i yɔrɔ sɔrɔ sisan. A kɛ tugun.
nearMe.insecure: Yɔrɔ dɔnniya bɛ se ka kɛ https sɔrɔda dɔrɔn na.

panorama.hint: A sama ka lajɛ · i ka telefɔni yɛlɛma
panorama.error: 360° lajɛ ma se ka don nin minɛn in kan.

proReports.subtitle: Filiw minnu bɔ taamalanw fɛ i ka sɛbɛnw kan. U labɛn walasa i ka kunnafoniw ka to a cogo la.
proReports.emptyText: Mɔgɔ si ma fili si lasɔmi i ka sɛbɛnw kan fɔlɔ.
